summary: MediaCo Holding Inc. filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing a Third Amendment dated November 2, 2026 to its First Lien Term Loan Credit Agreement with WhiteHawk Capital Partners LP as administrative and collateral agent. The amendment extends the maturity of the Delayed Draw Term Loans from October 31, 2026 to the earliest of November 30, 2026, an acceleration event, or 91 days before maturity of certain other debt. The agent acknowledged continuing defaults and events of default, reserving all rights and remedies; loan parties reaffirmed security interests and released known claims. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch for potential default escalation or forbearance negotiations.
